instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious country-inspired decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground with a strong central presence in a 9:16 frame. The envelope feels handcrafted, rustic yet refined, made from premium kraft paper with visible natural fibers, subtle grain, warm beige and caramel tones, muted sage green, terracotta, dusty blue and creamy ivory accents. Precise folds, tactile paper texture and elegant geometry. A finely detailed rustic wax seal or embossed emblem featuring a horseshoe, wildflower, cowboy boot or western star, combined with a delicate jute twine, leather cord or gingham ribbon closure. The envelope rests on a richly detailed country scene: a weathered wooden table on a ranch veranda, with softly blurred rolling fields, wooden fences, a red barn, wildflowers, hay bales and distant mountains creating depth and narrative context. Surrounding elements are carefully curated and organic, including daisies, sunflowers, dried grasses, wheat stems, small leaves, subtle dust particles and a few delicate petals arranged naturally around the envelope without overpowering it. Golden-hour cinematic lighting, with warm sunlight illuminating the paper texture, soft directional shadows, delicate rim light along the edges and subtle volumetric rays filtering through the rustic environment. Atmospheric dust and gentle haze catch the light, creating a warm, nostalgic, welcoming and premium country mood. Intentional harmonious color palette inspired by country living, rustic stationery and western editorial photography: kraft beige, tan, warm brown, sage green, muted denim blue, terracotta, sunflower yellow and ivory, with controlled contrast and natural highlights. Foreground-focused composition, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused but visually recognizable, strong depth and perspective. Macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper fibers, wax seal, embossing and twine details, cinematic bokeh in the background. Photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic rustic realism, elegant country aesthetic, handcrafted, warm, charming and premium. 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, editorial-grade rendering, suitable for country-themed invitations, celebrations and storytelling visuals. Sem franquias, sem texto legível, sem marcas d’água.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a blank white sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying almost the entire frame while preserving visible space around it to reveal the rustic floor, background and lateral decorative elements. The sheet is perfectly clean and empty, with no text, writing, symbols or printed details, featuring realistic paper texture, subtle fibers, softly matte surface and gently natural edges. It lies flat or slightly elevated over a rustic wooden floor, with carefully arranged country-style adornments surrounding it without covering its central writing area: small wildflowers, dried wheat stalks, delicate cotton branches, burlap details, twine, miniature wooden elements, subtle leather accents and scattered petals, all arranged organically along the edges and corners. The environment feels warm, authentic and story-driven, evoking a refined countryside setting with rustic wood, soft natural textures and tasteful handcrafted details. The background remains softly blurred but recognizable, showing hints of a country porch, wooden fence, barn-inspired architecture or open rural scenery, while the sheet remains the clear hero of the composition. Color palette: country-inspired warm beige, cream, off-white, caramel, terracotta, muted sage green, dusty yellow and rustic brown, with harmonious natural tones and subtle contrast. Lighting is cinematic and inviting, with soft warm sunlight illuminating the paper, delicate rim light defining its edges, gentle shadows on the wooden floor and subtle volumetric rays filtering through the background. Include a mild atmospheric haze and a few floating dust particles catching the light, creating a cozy, elegant and premium mood. Composition: large central blank sheet, occupying nearly the full frame, with balanced negative space for writing, visible floor beneath it, softly revealed background and decorative elements along both sides. Camera: slightly elevated three-quarter view, macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the paper texture and surrounding ornaments, cinematic bokeh in the background. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic country aesthetic, rustic elegance, warm, charming, premium stationery photography. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, soft volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, clean composition, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logo. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, visually inviting, suitable for personalized invitations, announcements, celebrations and storytelling visuals.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão vertical 9:16 elegante, na mesma atmosfera, no tema (Country) e na paleta de cores (Country). Como identificação do evento, escreva apenas "Aniversário julia". Escreva também a frase exata "Clique para abrir o convite!". Você não deve acrescentar data, horário, endereço ou outros dizeres, e deixe-as visíveis, legíveis e integradas ao design.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
